visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle drone sequence showcasing the Laomei Green Reef in Taiwan. Small groups of tourists are visible as tiny figures walking along the sandy shoreline. The central objects are long, parallel volcanic rock formations covered in vibrant green algae, resembling rows of mossy stones. The setting is an open coastal environment under bright, natural daylight with clear blue skies reflected in the seawater. No text overlays are present in this specific environmental opening. (2) The camera transitions to medium and close-up shots of the mossy rock ridges. Waves with white foam crash rhythmically against the sides of the green stones. A person wearing a black hat and casual clothing leans down to point a finger at the delicate green algae strands growing on the rock surface. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the moist texture of the stones and the clarity of the shallow tide pools surrounding them. (3) A warning sign is displayed prominently, featuring a red No Stepping symbol and black text. In the background, a small crowd of visitors, including adults and children in colorful casual wear, stands near the edge of the reef. The scene shifts back to wide aerial views of the entire coastline, showing the vast sandy beach and the turquoise ocean meeting the green-striped rocks. The lighting is consistent with a clear, sunny day.
